title: BrainRush Daily
one_line: Three quick brain puzzles every day, plus endless puzzle rounds and 30 levels of Gem Match. No sign-up.
how_to_play: Tap to solve the daily Pattern, Sudoku and Logic puzzles, then keep playing in the Play tab: swap gems in Gem Match, count, sort and spot the odd one out.
description:
BrainRush Daily gives you three short brain puzzles every day: a Pattern, a Sudoku and a Logic puzzle. Everyone gets the same ones on the same day, so you can compare with friends. There is no sign-up, and the game remembers where you stopped.

When you want more, open the Play tab. There you will find endless quick rounds: count the shapes, tap numbers from smallest to biggest or biggest to smallest, and find the one that does not belong. You will also find Gem Match, a 30-level puzzle where you swap neighbouring gems to line up three or more before your moves run out. Match four to make a blaster, and match five to make a bomb.

Each puzzle takes only a minute or two, so it fits into a break, a bus ride or a quiet evening. It is made for anyone who likes to keep their mind sharp, from school kids to grown-ups. If you fail a level, nothing is lost, and the next board is a little different.
controls: Tap to answer the daily Pattern, Sudoku and Logic puzzles.
Gem Match: swap two neighbouring gems to match three or more.
Number rounds: tap the numbers in order, as the question asks.
Count and odd-one-out rounds: tap your answer.
tips: Do the three daily puzzles first. They change every day.
In Gem Match, watch your moves left and plan ahead. A match of four makes a blaster, and five makes a bomb.
Lost a level? Just try again. Every board is a little different.
